The test image shows a very young soybean seedling that has completely wilted and collapsed near/at the soil line in sandy soil. Key features:
- Post-emergence damping-off pattern: seedling emerged with cotyledons/first leaves but has since completely collapsed
- Total wilt with yellowing/browning of leaves
- Stem collapse at soil line
- Sandy soil environment

The Pythium damping-off reference confirms this pattern: seedlings at early emergence stage failing and collapsing. The test image is a slightly more developed seedling (post-emergence) but shows the same damping-off collapse pattern characteristic of Pythium.
